hook: Most of 34 predicted compounds failed to form in the predicted structure when arc-melted
summary: The authors tried to make 34 ternary compounds that large databases predict to be stable, using arc melting. Most formed disordered variants or multiphase mixtures instead of the predicted structure, while four gave new ordered structures. They propose simple filters to screen out unlikely candidates. The sample is small and one synthesis method was used, so the failure rate is only a rough guide.
title: Experimental Evaluation of High-Throughput Structure Predictions
